verdict.rationale: Google Drive's own API docs describe push notifications that notify your application whenever a watched resource changes, backed by a changes resource. That is a first-party change-notification mechanism, but the pack never shows how deliveries are verified or retried, both explicit parts of the story. missing for 10: documented verification/authentication of notification deliveries, documented retry/redelivery semantics, details of channel registration and expiry, independent or hands-on corroboration
